title: Corrections
description: Corrections to course content (ADR 0051): a learner marks a sentence or a story line as incorrect and says what it should be. The app records a sentence_reported event; the server queues it for review; `nabu corrections apply` writes reviewed corrections into the course source.

TokenReading.title: TokenReading
TokenReading.description: One token's pinned reading in one scheme (Jyutping for yue). `token` counts the form's source tokens (its words, not spaces or punctuation), from 0; `surface` names it, so a reading never lands on another word.

CorrectedForm.title: CorrectedForm
CorrectedForm.description: One orthography's form of the item: its text and its tokens' readings.

text.description: The whole sentence, line or word form in this orthography, NFC.

CorrectionFields.title: CorrectionFields
CorrectionFields.description: Text, readings and translation of an item. In `shown`, everything the learner saw; in `correction`, only what they changed (a form's text, the readings they changed, the translation).

translation.description: The translation in the support language, as displayed (a sentence's first accepted translation; a word's gloss), NFC.

CorrectionStatus.title: CorrectionStatus
CorrectionStatus.description: pending: suggested by a learner; approved or rejected by a reviewer; applied: written into the course source by `nabu corrections apply`.

SentenceCorrection.title: SentenceCorrection
SentenceCorrection.description: A correction to one sentence, story line or word, as the review queue keeps it (GET /admin/v1/corrections.jsonl) and as the app exports a device's own: one JSON object per line, what `nabu corrections apply` reads. Identical corrections from several learners are one row.

orthography.description: The orthography the learner was using.

bundle.description: The bundle's manifest id the learner saw (sha256), if known.

item.description: A sentence id, a story id with `step`, or a word's KC id (ADR 0057).

step.description: For a story line: the step's index in the story (0-based, every step counted).

notes.description: What reporters wrote, if anything (the latest few).

reports.description: How many learners suggested this correction.
